question: Castor seed is rich in:
solution:
The correct answer is **Ricinoleic acid.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Castor seed is the **main source of castor oil.**
 
• **Ricinoleic acid, a hydroxy monounsaturated fatty acid, constitutes the majority of the fatty acid content in castor oil.**
 
• Castor oil is the **only commercially available vegetable oil that has the hydroxy functionality of a fatty acid **that is abundantly present. Castor oil is **sometimes referred to as ricinoleic acid triglyceride.**
 
• Castor-oil plant, (Ricinus communis), also called castor bean, large plant of the **spurge family (Euphorbiaceae).**
 
• It **contains 40% to 60% oil that is rich in triglycerides, but mainly ricinolein.**
 
• The seed also **contains a water-soluble toxin known as Ricin.**​
 
• Castor seed is **grown both as Rabi and Kharif crop.**
 
• Castor oil **also known as ‘Arandi ka tel’ in Hindi and ‘Amudham’ in Telugu.**

**Castor bean plant useful in fighting a major problem of 'soil pollution':**

 
• Castor seed plant is known to be one of the **most sturdiest plants.**
 
• It is** growing in areas where the soil is highly polluted, including in areas where mining is carried out.**
 
• Castor plants growing in these areas **absorb toxic heavy metals from soil.**
 
• Castor bean plants **can be grown in such polluted lands and over a period of time the levels of heavy metals can be reduced in the soil.**
 
• Castor plant has also been observed to** accelerate the remediation of polluted soils due to presence of some chemicals in them known as chelators** which enhances the capability of castor bean plant to accumulate heavy metals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****linoleic acid:**

__
 
• A **polyunsaturated fatty acid is present as a triglyceride in linseed oil and other oils and is essential in the human diet.**
 
• Double bonds are not conjugated.
 
• Occurs in** misconfiguration**.
 
• One of the two essential fatty acids required by the body.
 
• Occurs in** nuts and fatty seeds**.

**linolenic acid:** 

 
• It is also known as** α-linolenic acid.**
 
• **α-linolenic acid (C18H30O2)could be a form of omega-3 fatty acid found in plants.**
 
• It's **found in flaxseed oil, and in canola, soy, perilla, and walnut oils.**
 
• **α-linolenic acid is comparable to the omega-3 fatty acids that are in fish oil, known as eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA)**.

**Oleic acid:**

 
• **Oleic acid(C18H34O2)** could be a** colorless to pale yellow liquid with a mild odor.**
 
• It** floats on water.**
 
• It has a** role as a substance, an E. coli metabolite, a plant metabolite, a solvent, an antioxidant, and a mouse matter.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India is known as the world leader in castor seed and oil production and leads the international castor oil trade.**
 
• Approximately **86% of castor seed production in India is concentrated in Gujarat, followed by Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan.**
